title: Add unit tests for startup provider validation

Tests: probeProviderConnection_skipsNoAuth, skipsOAuthNoToken, returns401AsInvalid, returns200AsValid, handlesTimeout, validateProvidersOnStartup_updatesTestStatus, handlesEmptyConnections, handlesDBError, batchesConcurrency.
